$comment: Single source of truth for generated sprites. Edit subjects/style here, then run `python3 tools/sprites/manifest.py render`. Each unit has a 32x32 map sprite and a 64x64 battle sprite from the same subject. See assets/sprites/README.md.

units.prefix: Tiny map unit sprite in the style of Advance Wars Dual Strike
units.suffix: Very simple chunky shapes, bold silhouette, few colors, readable at a glance
units.post: Raw download to assets/sprites/originals/units/{faction}/; stand ground and naval units on row 30 (fliers stay as drawn), then python3 tools/sprites/idle_frames.py OUT.png --feet 3 (walkers) or --feet 0 (boats and fliers bob whole)

battle.prefix: Full body view of a character for a battle scene
battle.suffix: Grounded storybook medieval woodland setting with anthropomorphic animals (like Root or Redwall), no magic, charming but battle-ready, clear readable silhouette

tiles.prefix: Pixel art seamless top-down ground tile texture
tiles.suffix: Storybook medieval woodland palette, soft 3-tone shading, light from the upper left, tiles seamlessly on all four edges, flat ground only with no tall objects, fills the whole square, no outline, no text

features.prefix: Whimsical storybook terrain sprite for a tactics map in the style of Advance Wars Dual Strike, drawn at the scale of small woodland animals (a forest floor seen by a mouse, not a landscape)
features.suffix: Seen from the front, isolated, nothing underneath it: no grass, no ground, no platform. Soft colored outlines, bright cheerful palette

pixellab.size: one object per call at 32x32, or a sheet of several (128x64 for a 4x2 grid) to save generations

features.post: Slice the sheet by gaps (objects don't sit on the grid), fit each into 32x32 standing on the bottom row, then python3 tools/sprites/soften_outline.py; keep the raw download in assets/sprites/originals/features/

portraits.prefix: Pixel art character portrait, head and shoulders, facing slightly right
portraits.suffix: Grounded storybook medieval woodland setting with anthropomorphic animals (like Root or Redwall), no magic, expressive face. Crisp 1px dark outline, 3-4 tone shading, light from the upper left. Plain dark brown background #4E321C, no text, no border

pixellab.style_image: assets/sprites/anchors/western-portrait.png (Dusty) for every army, with Copy from style image: Color palette unticked so the army colours come through

portraits.post: Keep the raw download in assets/sprites/originals/portraits/; the image is used as-is (64x64, plain dark brown background)
